amendments.trigger_run: local native-Windows shard attempt at repository commit c0e6e72
amendments.observation: The first Adult shard correctly omitted TabPFN for education and occupation because both targets exceed ten classes, but the initial CUDA gate incorrectly required positive CUDA allocation from those XGB/KNN-only arms.
amendments.change: Apply the positive CUDA-allocation gate only to arms for which TabPFN is protocol-applicable; retain zero-allocation evidence for high-cardinality arms that must omit TabPFN.
amendments.unchanged: Datasets, target coverage, seeds, surrogate, predictor panel and high-cardinality omission policy, stability thresholds, and numerical resource limits.

environment.platform: native Windows 11 x86_64 with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080

surrogate.purpose: Exercise both TRTR and TSTR evaluator arms without attributing quality to a generator.

resources.measurement_scope: Python process plus recursive child-process RSS and CUDA device-0 allocated memory sampled for every arm

predictor_policy.high_cardinality_policy: TabPFN may be omitted only for classification targets with more than ten real-train classes; XGB and KNN remain mandatory.

claim_boundary: Repeats the unchanged 67-task Adult/Sick surrogate schedule and fixed 0.05 stability gates on the preregistered native Windows/Python 3.11/RTX 5080 runtime. It does not evaluate generator quality, generalize to other GPUs, or admit Official Results.
